title: Indices of M5 and M2 branes at finite $N$ from equivariant volumes, and a new duality
summary: We study supersymmetric indices of the 6d $(2,0)$ theory of $N$ M5-branes on toric Sasaki-Einstein five-manifolds. Embedding the background into a local toric Calabi-Yau four-fold and equivariantly integrating the anomaly polynomial yields a finite-$N$ Cardy-limit formula in terms of equivariant characteristic classes. Separately, using equivariant constant maps in topological string theory and higher-derivative supergravity, we derive a finite-$N$ proposal for the superconformal, twisted and spindle indices of $N$ M2-branes probing arbitrary toric Calabi-Yau four-folds.
